recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future ConceptMap changes should preserve string/text support on dependsOn/product values unless the Vocabulary/TI work group explicitly narrows the model.
issue_request: FHIR-15604 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary change request to rename ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.code to ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value and define that value to include text, enabling uncoded mapping dependencies such as LIVD vendor descriptions.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the change was pre-applied as svn 13289. In git history this is 6d19edc3d4af224136214ed97d4137d56841f757, which changed ConceptMap dependsOn/product example and spreadsheet source from code to value.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. Later R5/R6 ConceptMap work refactored the applied value element to ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.value[x] with allowed types including string. FHIR-32541, FHIR-40504, and FHIR-33032 are later ConceptMap dependsOn/property/type decisions already represented on the combined branch and do not reverse text value support.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active StructureDefinition has dependsOn.value[x] with string among its allowed types, and the $translate dependsOn.value output parameter also allows string. The only current dependsOn.code hit is a legacy [r3-renames] map to dependsOn.value, not an active element definition.

related_jiras.note: Clarified dependsOn.property/value usage and is already audited on the combined branch; it does not reverse the FHIR-15604 text value capability.
Refactored ConceptMap properties/attributes while retaining dependsOn.value[x] string support and is already audited on the combined branch.
Later extended ConceptMap dependsOn/product value types with id and is already fixed on the combined branch.
